$comment: Provenance record for the seed imagery. Replaces scripts/generate-seed-images.mjs,
which regenerated navy 'AGBN — PLACEHOLDER IMAGE' gradients and would silently
overwrite these files if it were ever run again.
SCOPE: this file covers the CMS seed imagery only. The homepage hero and
gallery are separate curated files under public/home/ and are documented in
src/components/HomeGallery/index.tsx. They are generated under the same rules
and carry the same interim status.
STATUS: every image below is AI-generated and stands in for photography AGBN has
not commissioned yet. Brand DNA §5.5 requires real photography. These images are
closer to that bar than the gradients were, but they do not meet it. Real
photography lands in the gallery section; replace these as it arrives and drop the
matching entry's "generated" flag when you do.
Two rules learned the hard way, worth keeping if you regenerate anything:
1. z_image has no negative conditioning. Writing 'no handshake' PRODUCED a
handshake — the one composition Brand DNA §5.5 names explicitly. Never phrase a
constraint as an exclusion; positively describe what is in frame instead.
2. Give every person in a frame a distinct, physically separate task. That is what
structurally prevents the handshake / posed-group compositions, not asking for
